### 🚀 Pre-Release: v2.0.0b16 (Field-Testing Beta)

<!-- DRAFT: paste into the GitHub release body when tagging 2.0.0b16. Recount the pull
     requests and add any merged after 2026-10-21 (`git log 2.0.0b15..2.0.0b16
     --first-parent`). Delete this file in the commit that tags the release. -->

83 pull requests since b15, on **OWNd 2.0.0b11**. Requires Home Assistant 2026.3 or newer.

#### ⚠️ Behaviour changes: covers (WHO 2), #466 / #702

- **Advanced covers: `set_cover_position: 100` is now a plain UP.** It sends the same frame as the open button (`*2*1*WHERE##`) instead of the level command `*#2*WHERE*#11#001*100##`, and `0` is a plain DOWN. Both are full runs to the limit switch, also when the actuator already reports that end. Not yet verified on an F454 / MH201.
- **Timed covers: `set_cover_position: 0` / `100` sends no stop frame and settles on a timer.** The motor stops on its limit switch. The entity reports 0 % / 100 % once the stored travel time plus 2 s has passed, instead of waiting for the actuator's own stop status (about 60 s late on a MyHOMEServer1, never on a gateway that does not relay it). Automations waiting for `open` / `closed` see the change at that point, which can be a few seconds before a slow curtain physically arrives. The open and close buttons are unchanged.
- **Small moves are widened or stretched, so they are no longer exact.** A timed cover runs at least its `min_motor_pulse` (default 0.4 s, set per cover in YAML or with `myhome.set_cover_travel_time`; `0` turns it off), and the estimate books that longer run (50 % → 51 % on a 5 s cover ends at 58 % with the default). An advanced cover is sent at least a 2 % level change (50 % → 51 % is sent as 52 %). A move whose run reaches an end becomes a full run to that end. Sending the cover to 0 % or 100 % re-syncs it (#708).
- **No widening while an advanced cover is moving.** While the actuator runs it reports the level it started from, so a retarget goes out as asked (40 → 80, then `set_cover_position: 40` sends the level frame).
- **A timed cover with no restored state starts `unknown`, not `open` at 50 %.** The actuator cannot report its position, so none is invented. It becomes known at the first end stop: the open / close buttons and `set_cover_position: 0` / `100` run to the limit switch and settle on the travel time plus 2 s even when the actuator's own stop status comes earlier (an F411/2 timed shorter than `travel_time`), a keypad run that lasts the full travel time anchors it too; until then `set_cover_position` with another target is refused with a translated error and sends nothing. The position restored from the last run of Home Assistant is kept; a restored `open` without a position stays open with an unknown position, it is no longer turned into 100 %. A direction frame that never reaches the bus leaves the cover as it was. An area / group / general cover is `unknown` while none of its members has a known state, and a `set_cover_position` behind an F422 is refused before any member moves when one of them is unknown. A Venetian blind's slat angle follows the same rule: `set_cover_tilt_position: 0` / `100` run a full rotation to the slat stop, any other angle is refused until then.
- **Timed runs end at the actuator's stop status.** When the gateway relays `*2*0*WHERE##` after a stop, the position and `last_run_seconds` are taken from that status instead of the moment the stop was written, which was about 0.5 s short per run on a MyHOMEServer1 (#707). A keypad run that lasts the full travel time is now reported as reaching the end (#760).

See the cover docs for the details and the known limits.

#### ⚠️ Other behaviour changes

- **`myhome.send_message` and `myhome.sync_time` reject unknown keys.** A misspelt key such as `gw_mac` or a missing `message` raises a validation error instead of sending the frame to the default gateway; both services get text selectors in the visual editor (#189).
- **Climate zones show the setpoint in force (dimension 12).** When the thermostat regulates to another setpoint than the commanded one (dimension 14; 23.5 in force while 21.0 commanded on an F461), the entity and `local_target_temperature` now show the one in force instead of the commanded value plus the knob offset. Known limit: once a zone has reported dimension 12, a dimension 14 that is not the echo of a Home Assistant write does not move the slider until the next dimension 12 report or poll (see Known Limitations).
- **`myhome.sync_time` refuses time zones with a half-hour offset** (e.g. `Asia/Kolkata`, UTC+5:30) with a translated error. The WHO 13 time-zone field carries whole hours only; b15 (on OWNd 2.0.0b10) set the gateway clock with a truncated offset without saying so (#764).
- **`advanced: true` on a standard F411 shutter now logs a startup warning.** Those actuators have no position reporting, so the position stayed at 50 % and calibration was refused; the error now says to remove `advanced: true` (#761, #762).

#### Other changes

- **Diagnostics**: the gateway profile block reports the OWNd profile's real `model_name`, `display_name`, `event_keepalive_interval` and `keepalive_summary` instead of `Generic` / 90 s for every gateway.
- **Setup**: when `myhome.yaml` has gateway sections but none under this gateway's MAC, a warning names the entry MAC and the section keys that match no configured gateway (#106).
- **Expose Home Assistant to the bus**: a declarative `expose` engine projects HA entities and the clock onto free SCS addresses: virtual WHO 1 / WHO 2 actuators that a wall control can drive (mirroring HA state back to its LEDs), WHO 4 virtual temperature probes, WHO 18 virtual energy meters and the WHO 13 bus clock. Custom actions run as Home Assistant scripts (#750).
- **Covers**: `class:` in `myhome.yaml` now reaches WHO 2 covers (a `curtain` is no longer shown as a shutter; #39); Venetian blind slat tilt as timed slat pulses (`slat_tilt`, `slat_time`) (#508); impulse garage and gate covers on WHO 1 relays with optional safety approval, door-entry strike locks and doorbell events (#667); native broadcast for general covers behind an interface (#679); a cover stop overtakes other queued frames (#694); cover kinematics split into pluggable strategies (#739).
- **Lighting**: 2-digit Area 0 point addresses `01`–`09` (#713); ON dimmers on a fresh install are probed for brightness support (#742); timed turn-on uses the OWNd builders (#659); lights the startup sweep already reported are not polled again (#701); area and group re-syncs only skip once every member has echoed, counting only the members' own echoes in the commanded state (#740, #749).
- **Thermoregulation (WHO 4)**: each zone asks for its actuators (dimension 20) after the startup sweep and after a reconnect, so `hvac_action` is known at start; the new `actuators` attribute lists them (#25, #44); zone humidity is not polled on F450, F453, F453AV, F454, H4684, MH200, MH200N and MH202, where the emulated firmware did not forward `*#4*<WHERE>*60##` (own-firmware-oracle PR #60, unpublished; an OWNd profile flag `supports_heating_humidity_request` overrides the table); season frames, a generic setpoint mode and the central unit's season (#657, #725); holiday and vacation program attributes (#689); zone humidity remembered and queried at startup (#712); F461 zones polled, AUTO on standalone zones, fan coils per season, season kept across restarts (#714, #715); `hvac_action` derived from the season when the actuator carries no heating flag (#721); standalone default follows the plant (#698); 10 s command timeouts on the F455 removed (#675); migrated to the `native_*` temperature API (#665).
- **Sound system**: tuner frequency, preset and RDS read from WHO 22, with optional per-frequency pictures (#695); sound source commands and wall transport steps (#651); amplifiers no longer woken by volume status reports (#670); one decision engine for the power state (#683); an idle decoder can be claimed from a parked group (#723).
- **Scenarios**: WHO 25 Scenario Plus commands and events (#671); WHO 17 scene events (#656).
- **Gateways**: H4684 / LGRH4684 and MH201 identification (#652, #722); kernel and distribution in the diagnostic sweep (#711); user commands go ahead of status polls (#685); one frame scheduler with per-target ordering (#738); the HA web session is used for discovery (#757).
- **Setup and migration**: device settings that only exist in `myhome.yaml` (travel times, feature flags) are copied into the config entry, so they survive if the file is removed; while the file exists it stays in charge (#742). Blank-start discovery skips phantom entities (#686). `ignored_addresses` can be cleared in the options (#666). Restored sensors keep their entity IDs (#678), and legacy entity names survive the Home Assistant 2026.11 registry migration (#727). Brand icons are bundled for Home Assistant 2026.3+ and HACS (#741).
- **Energy (WHO 18)**: active power queries and the Dimension 1200 stream lifecycle aligned (#661).
- **Robustness**: stricter checks on infeasible service input, WebSocket frames and volume bounds (#747); no private OWNd access or runtime shims left (#737, #745); `mypy --strict` checked against the pinned OWNd 2.0.0b11 (#765).
- **Tests and CI**: live traces from F461, F454, F455, F453AV, MH200, MH200N, MH202 and MyHomeServer1 plants are replayed in CI, and gateway profiles are checked against the firmware oracle (#720, #743, #745, #766). Home Assistant deprecations fail CI (#728, #729). 4,393 tests passing at 100 % statement coverage.
